snippet.title: Starvester - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the reveal trailer for Starvester, a short incremental game about expanding a star-system-wide factory to build giant megastructures in space. In Starvester, players will deploy drones to automate mining, build megastructures, and harvest the unlimited power of stars and other celestial bodies. Starvester is coming soon to PC (Steam).
